# Escaped newlines before configuration keys in C++ parser fixtures.
\\n(?=[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*\s*=)

# Floating-point precision in millisecond timing output.
%\.[0-9]+f(?=ms\b)

# PowerShell timestamp format used for diagnostic trace filenames.
\byyyyMMdd-HHmmss\b

# MSBuild file logger switch.
(?<=/)flp(?=:)

# Bash strict-mode flags in the release workflow.
\bset -euo\b
